raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the genotype of the "pure dominant" parent. The problem explicitly states the parent is "pure dominant," which means it must be homozygous dominant (RR). However, the Planner assumed the parent was heterozygous (Rr) in its analysis ("Cross is Rr rr"). This fundamental misunderstanding of the term "pure dominant" led to an incorrect Punnett square analysis (calculating a 1:1 ratio instead of 100% dominant phenotype) and the selection of the wrong answer (B instead of A).
